tasks.title: Announcement #63
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention everyone. We are excited to announce that the university's annual book fair will be held next Friday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. in the student center. There will be author signings, book sales and workshops. We look forward to seeing you there.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.B: A change in an event's location

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are excited to announce that the university's annual book fair will be held next Friday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. in the student center. 选项分析： A. A new bookstore opening 一家新书店的开业。公告中未提及新书店开业，所以A选项错误。 B. A change in an event's location 活动地点的变更。公告中未提及地点变更，所以B选项错误。 C. A writing workshop 一个写作工作坊。公告中提到有工作坊，但只是书展的一部分，不是主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. An upcoming book fair 一场即将到来的书展。公告明确宣布年度书展的时间地点，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We look forward to seeing you there. 选项分析： A. Visit the bookstore 去书店。公告中提到的是书展（book fair），不是书店，所以A选项错误。 B. Attend the book fair 参加书展。说话者说“期待在那里见到你”，即希望听众到场参加书展，所以B选项正确。 C. Submit their manuscripts 提交他们的手稿。公告中未提及提交手稿，所以C选项错误。 D. Join the workshops 参加工作坊。公告中提到有工作坊，但说话者说的是“期待见到你”，并未特指参加工作坊，所以D选项不够准确。
